detail: Live reproduction: a generic named teammate (Tools: *) DOES inherit mcp__plugin_twining_twining__* tools via ToolSearch; twining:twining-aware-worker spawned in the same session reported exactly [Read, Write, Edit, Bash] — no twining tools, no ToolSearch. Root cause H1 (confirmed): plugin/agents/*.md tools: allowlists use bare names; real names are mcp__plugin_twining_twining__* (prefix varies by install mode — mcp__twining__* for standalone .mcp.json, see commit 7bd906a). Compounding: twining_decide/twining_query and 19 of coordinator's 32 names are full-surface-only (config full_surface:false hides them); neither agent lists twining_record (the Gate-2 tool); twining-dispatch SKILL mandates full-surface-only twining_register/twining_delegate; coordinator has no file tools at all. Alternate field branches if teammates were generic: H2 stdio server fails to spawn in cmux pane (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset → .mcp.json sh -c exec fails silently; README.md:139 documents class), H3 plugin not enabled in pane's config scope (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / worktree lacking project settings). Field checks: ask failing teammate to list literal tool names; /mcp; mcp-logs-twining cache logs; echo $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; launch-server.sh --probe. Fixes in twining's control: drop tools: key from both agent files (docs: omitted ⇒ all tools), rewrite coordinator body, audit skills/agents against default surface with CI assertion, harden against unset CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, README section for cmux/agent teams. Immediate workaround: spawn teammates with generic agentType, not twining:* types.
summary: Reproduced: plugin agent types get ZERO twining tools — frontmatter tools: allowlists use bare names (twining_assemble) that never match real mcp__* names; ToolSearch also missing from the lists
